classes.name: Fifidianana ny Filohan'ny Repoblika / Élection présidentielle
classes.finest_note: Polling station (CENI provisional results for 2018 and 2023); the HCC's arrêts give national totals.
classes.locator: https://www.hcc.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/CONSTITUTION-IV.pdf (Art. 45: direct universal suffrage, five-year term renewable once; Art. 47: absolute majority of votes cast, else a runoff of the two leaders within 30 days of the official first-round results)
classes.note: Direct since 1965; Philibert Tsiranana was first chosen by Parliament on 1 May 1959 (class president_parlement). Elections in 1965, 1972, 1982, 1989, 1992-93, 1996, 2001, 2006, 2013, 2018, and 2023; the dates before 2006 are not on an official site and are listed without a source. In 1975 Didier Ratsiraka was confirmed by the referendum of 21 December 1975 (class referendum). The 2013 rounds were judged by the Cour Électorale Spéciale. The transition that began in October 2025 leaves the next date open.

cadence.runoff_rule: An absolute majority of votes cast wins; otherwise the two leading candidates meet within 30 days of the official first-round results (Art. 47).
cadence.administered_by: Commission Électorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI); final results by the Haute Cour Constitutionnelle

classes.finest_note: Polling station for 2024 (CENI) and constituency (district) for 2019; the HCC's arrêts list the elected deputies and, for 2019, one result sheet per constituency.
classes.locator: https://www.hcc.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/CONSTITUTION-IV.pdf (Art. 69: deputies elected by direct universal suffrage for five years, the system set by organic law; Art. 70: the number of seats and the constituencies set by decree)
classes.note: Since 2019, plurality in single-seat constituencies and one-round closed-list PR (highest average) in two-seat constituencies (loi organique n° 2019-002). 151 seats in 119 constituencies in 2019 (87 single, 32 double) and 163 in 120 in 2024 (77 single, 43 double). The First Republic Assembly was elected in 1960, 1965, and 1970 and suspended after the 1972 referendum; the People's National Assembly in 1977, 1983, and 1989; the National Assembly again from 1993 (1993, 1998, 2002, 2007, 2013, 2019, 2024). Dates before 2007 are not on an official site and are listed without a source. Partial elections rerun annulled constituencies.

classes.name: Fifidianana ny Ben'ny tanàna sy ny Mpanolotsaina / Élections communales et municipales
classes.name_en: Communal elections: mayors and municipal and communal councils
classes.finest_note: Commune (CENI provisional results for 2019 and 2024; the 2024 district PDFs annex polling-station sheets); final results are judgments of the six administrative courts and are not published as data.
classes.locator: https://www.cnlegis.gov.mg/uploads/D2024-1495-VF.pdf (Art. 2, quoting Art. 306 of loi n° 2014-020 as amended by loi n° 2023-023: one list ballot, five-year term, the head of the leading list becomes mayor, electoral quotient and largest remainder)
classes.note: Mayors and councils of all 1,695 communes, urban (municipal councils) and rural (communal councils); Antananarivo, Nosy Be, and Sainte Marie have special status. In 2015 and from 2024 one list ballot elects the council and its head becomes mayor; in 2019 the mayor and the council were on separate ballots (CENI 2019 report), so 2019 counts two contests per commune. Communal elections under earlier laws were held from 1995 to 2008 but are not counted from an official list. Mandates lapsed on 10 January 2024 and were extended by HCC avis n° 01-HCC/AV of 25 January 2024.

cadence.administered_by: Commission Électorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI); final results by the administrative courts (tribunaux administratifs)

classes.name: Conseil régional et Chef de région
classes.locator: https://www.hcc.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/CONSTITUTION-IV.pdf (Art. 154-155: the chef de région and the regional council elected by universal suffrage; deputies and senators sit by right)
classes.disposition_reason: Never held: no regional election has been organized under the 2010 Constitution or loi n° 2014-020; chefs de région are appointed by decree.

classes.name: Conseil provincial et Chef de province
classes.name_en: Provincial councils and provincial heads (2010 Constitution)
classes.disposition_reason: Never held: the provinces of the 2010 Constitution have no elected organs yet.

classes.name: Conseils provinciaux des provinces autonomes
classes.note: Created by the 1998 revision (referendum of 15 March 1998); the councils were elected on 3 December 2000 and elected the 2001 Senate; the 2007 revision abolished the autonomous provinces.
classes.disposition_reason: No official body publishes the 3 December 2000 provincial-council results online: the HCC's arrêts start in 2004 and CENI did not exist.

classes.name: Fokontany, Firaisampokontany, Fivondronampokontany, Faritany (Deuxième République)
classes.name_en: People's councils and executive committees of the Second Republic
classes.note: The 1975 Constitution built the decentralized collectivities on elected people's assemblies at the fokontany, firaisana, fivondronana, and faritany levels; elections were held from 1977 into the 1980s.
classes.disposition_reason: No official body publishes results of the Second Republic's collectivity elections online.

dates.note: Collectivity elections of the Second Republic; not counted from an official list.

classes.name: Sénat de la Première République
classes.note: 54 members: two thirds elected by provincial and communal bodies (five per province in 1959, by the congress of provincial assemblies), one third appointed; six-year terms renewed by half every three years. Suspended after the 1972 referendum.
classes.disposition_reason: Results appear only in the Journal officiel of the First Republic, which no official body publishes online; senat.mg gives only dates.

dates.note: Five senators per province elected by the congress of provincial assemblies for a provisional term (seated 1 July 1959); later elections dated 2 October 1963 and 3 May 1967 on senat.mg do not fit its own periods.

classes.name: Élection du Président de la République par le Parlement (1959)
classes.note: Philibert Tsiranana was elected by the two chambers on 1 May 1959; from 1965 the President is elected directly.
classes.disposition_reason: The parliamentary vote is recorded only in the Journal officiel of 1959, which is not online from an official body.

classes.name: Assemblée représentative et assemblées provinciales (1945-1958)
classes.name_en: Colonial representative and provincial assemblies, and the 1958 constituent congress
classes.note: The territory's representative assembly and the provincial assemblies (last elected 31 March 1957), whose congress proclaimed the Malagasy Republic on 14 October 1958 and sat as the constituent and legislative assembly until 1960.
classes.disposition_reason: Results appear only in the colonial Journal officiel, which no Malagasy official body publishes online.

dates.note: Colonial assembly elections; not counted from an official list.

classes.name: Élections au Parlement français
classes.name_en: French Parliament and the 1958 French referendum
classes.disposition_reason: Elections of deputies and senators to the French Parliament from Madagascar, and the referendum of 28 September 1958, belong to the France census.

classes.name: Chef fokontany
classes.locator: https://www.hcc.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/CONSTITUTION-IV.pdf (Art. 152: the fokontany is an administrative subdivision of the commune, not a decentralized collectivity)
classes.disposition_reason: The chef fokontany is named by arrêté of the district head; any residents' designation before it is not an election administered by CENI and no official body publishes its results.

classes.name: Haute Cour Constitutionnelle et magistrature
classes.locator: https://www.hcc.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/CONSTITUTION-IV.pdf (Art. 114: nine HCC judges, three appointed by the President, two elected by the National Assembly, one by the Senate, three by the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature)
classes.disposition_reason: No judge is popularly elected: HCC judges are appointed or chosen by the chambers and the magistracy council, and other judges are appointed.

classes.name: Primaires
classes.disposition_reason: The state runs no nominating contest: parties and groups nominate candidates, and the HCC validates candidacies.

classes.name: Chambres de commerce et d'industrie, chambres d'agriculture
classes.disposition_reason: Chamber members are chosen by their own members outside the general electoral regime of loi organique n° 2018-008; CENI does not administer them and no official body publishes results.

classes.name: Établissements publics et organismes de coopération intercommunale
classes.disposition_reason: No special-purpose district is popularly elected; intercommunal bodies (OPCI) are made up of delegates of the member communes.
